newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest estimate cut.

text.p: -- Brown Brothers Harriman analyst Raphael Soifer cut his 1997 earnings estimate on National Westminster Bank Plc to 76 pence per share from 82 pence
-- The analyst said he was keeping his estimate for 1998 at 86 pence per share but would review that forecast as the year progressed.
-- He said the reduction in his 1997 estimate reflected additional investment spending and the absence of specific plans for further share repurchases.
-- Soifer expects a dividend of 33 pence in 1997, up 14 percent from 1996.
